'''Carmal''' was the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of [[Lavisar/Legends|Lavisar]] during [[7 ABY/Legends|7.5 ABY]]. He enjoyed [[sunfruit]] liqueur, which [[Wraith Squadron]] planned to present as a gift when they approached the neutral Lavisar in seeking the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] allegiance in the battle against [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] after the [[Battle of Lavisar]].
